source_prior.encoder: Original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50/11100, 232993 parameters, default six-class head unchanged
source_prior.restorer: Frozen DURA v1.0 R69, 266951 parameters, FP32 TF32off reuse/graph true native false
source_prior.readout: paired_mlp16_step1000, P1descriptor100 then P0descriptor100, 3233 parameters, source L/OE role-domain membership supervision
source_prior.thresholds: Six frozen predicted-old-class scalar thresholds; no reoptimization, original parent known42 constraints must pass
source_prior.new_source_IQ: L6300 only, reuse fixed G10 P0/P1 cache; no new OE/V/novel/Us inputs
source_prior.new_source_state: 90 L oldTX/RX/day group means of P1 688D embedding and per-row knownness margin; no source row bank

target.input: One fixed G10 received per physical ID; original F0 on P0 and same IQ DURA/F0 on P1; identity uses P1
target.clustering: All U, stable opaque-ID order; Euclidean average linkage; choose highest full-U silhouette among K=2..floor(sqrt(N)) partitions with each cluster>=8; tie smaller K; none means no clusters
target.radius: Per cluster 0.95 quantile of leave-one-out distances to remaining-member embedding means, floor1e-6
target.adaptation: If Q lies within radius of its nearest U cluster, half original and half cluster-mean P1 logits and scalar raw rejection margin; otherwise unchanged. No model/head fitting or Q statistics
target.anonymous_registration: All-U cluster>=16 with negative full mean raw margin and negative means in both opaque-ID alternating halves; unknown count remains free including zero
target.joint_prediction: Old margins (logits-max)/30+tanh(rawmargin); anonymous 1-distance/radius minus per-anon source90-anchor protection penalty; all old and anonymous compete, reject only max<0
target.mapping: Independent scorer only, one-to-one Hungarian on U truth frozen for future Q; unmatched anonymous accepted wrong

entry_and_promotion.entry: Source prior and method frozen before U/Q; existing known42 risk checks pass. New coupled development falsification runs all four states once even though standalone source unknown rejection was below target
entry_and_promotion.future_new_accuracy_scope: A_N>=80% is an overall gate; per-scene A_N reported without an additional 80% gate. Required arrival coverage remains necessary for per-scene intended-registered acceptance
entry_and_promotion.promotion: No formal or seed expansion unless full crossRX star old acceptance90/rejection90/F0loss2pp and positive old-AK adaptation, new80/registration oldloss2pp/intended acceptance90/later rejection90, all required main scene coverage. Missing groups cannot certify
entry_and_promotion.scientific_failure: Preserve results; no target-driven retuning, reselected partition, alternate threshold or selective rerun

stop: Technical legality/provenance/collision/nonfinite/incomplete prediction stops preserve output; scientific failure or zero anonymous clusters is not a technical retry
